case.believed: startTransition defers its callback and returns its value, while useId produces random server-rendered identifiers that cannot be namespaced across roots.
contract: startTransition invokes its callback synchronously and returns undefined instead of the callback's return value.
startTransition propagates a synchronous exception from its callback.
useId returns distinct identifiers for multiple hooks and renderToString connects them to for and aria-describedby attributes.
Repeated renderToString calls for the same component root produce the same useId identifiers.
renderToString identifierPrefix namespaces every useId value for a separate server-rendered root.
case.goal: Prove React 18.3.1 useId server-rendering identifiers and startTransition synchronous callback/return behavior in a pinned Node contract.
